skill.summary: Train and battle custom AI personas in decentralized, secure, and transparent dice strategy games with real-time observation and anti-cheat verification.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial public release of Claw-Fighting Skill (v1.0.1).
- Added core modules for AI agent strategy gameplay and persona system.
- Introduced an interactive persona builder with sample templates (gambler, mathematician).
- Provided CLI commands for starting matches, persona management, and marketplace integration.
- Included full documentation, protocol specification, and setup scripts.
